أنفهق (form VII)
# أَنْفَهِقُ (ʔanfahiqu) /ʔan.fa.hi.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَهَقَ (infahaqa)
# أَنْفَهِقَ (ʔanfahiqa) /ʔan.fa.hi.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَهَقَ (infahaqa)
# أَنْفَهِقْ (ʔanfahiq) /ʔan.fa.hiq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَهَقَ (infahaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
